_comment: Footnote street-audio preset — the `filters` array for the relay media source (the ffmpeg_source OBS uses as its SRT caller, e.g. `moblin-feed`). OBS has no UI to import this file directly; either click it in by hand (tools/street/obs-audio-preset.md, ~60 seconds) or splice this array into the source's `filters` key in the scene collection JSON at ~/Library/Application Support/obs-studio/basic/scenes/<Collection>.json with OBS FULLY QUIT (OBS rewrites that file on exit and will clobber live edits). Order matters: the EQ must precede the limiter so the ceiling reacts to the de-rumbled signal. Filter `uuid`s are intentionally omitted — OBS 31+ generates them on load.
